newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria agency approves Devnya Cement sale.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria agency approves Devnya Cement sale.

text.p: The executive board of Bulgaria's Privatisation Agency on Tuesday approved the purchase of 70 percent of Devnya Cement by Bulgarian-Spanish investment consortium Marvex for $44.5 million.

The consortium was set up for the privatisation deal and the Spanish side, led by Moltiracion De Graneles, holds 80 percent. The remaining 20 percent is held by Bulgarian private company ELVA, which distributes Russian Lada cars in Bulgaria.
The deadline for signing the contract is May 5.
Marvex said it had pledged to invest $209.5 million in the plant over the next five years.

Devnya Cement, which exports 44 percent of its production, had a turnover of 2.9 million levs in 1995. Marvex plans to increase annual capacity to 4.5 million tonnes in the next five years from the current 1.8 million tonnes. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 981 4145
